When: September 1, 8 15, 22, and 29. Cost: $50 per person, $10 per week. What to bring: Athletic shoes, water bottle, Paddles are available to borrow. Format: Separate games, rotating partners.

d147c29b5f83.d: You are your child’s most important advocate. This training will give you the knowledge and confidence to make sure they receive the support they need. You will learn how special education works, understand your rights, and discover practical strategies to become an equal partner with your child’s school. Whether your child is just starting the evaluation process or already has an IEP, you’ll leave with tools you can use right away to help your child succeed.
